annotations.title: Check whether a website is ready for agents

description: Is a website ready for agents? Send a domain (like example.com). We look for /llms.txt, an A2A agent card (/.well-known/agent-card.json) and an MCP server card (/.well-known/mcp.json), say what is found, what is missing and why it matters. Free. Nothing is stored. Public sites only (https, ports 80/443), up to 6 requests per check. Fetches with the user agent 'Countersign/1.0 (independent checker; LLPRO)'. robots.txt is not read.

domain.description: Domain name to check, e.g. example.com (a full URL is accepted; only the host name is used).

name: agent_ready_check
